1997-2009 • Reality TV • Mitch Pileggi • 46 min

Description
The magician's sacred code of silence is broken forever in the 18-episode season produced for television by Bruce Nash. BREAKING THE MAGICIAN'S CODE reveals to the world the biggest secrets of magic for the first time anywhere. In each hour-long episode, the mysterious Masked Magician will show viewers how a magician accomplishes his incredible illusions. The magic tricks revealed on the show range from the small to the impossibly large. He exposes an average of nine magic tricks per episode, revealing the secrets behind tricks which have captivated audiences for centuries.
